card.name: Counting vials in preparation steps
card.fires_on: The word "number" (or "units", "unit", "of" after it) in preparation instructions, as in "determine the number of vials" to reconstitute. It appears in dose-preparation steps for injectable drugs.

modes.label: Determine the number of vials
modes.description: "number" after determine, calculate or correct, just before "of vials" in reconstitution steps.
modes.example: Reconstitution Instructions 1. Determine the<< number>> of 35 mg and 5

modes.label: Unit or count of packaged items
modes.description: "unit" or "units" or "of" naming how many packaged items are used.
modes.example: Add the entire contents of one<< unit>>-dose packet of NUZOLV

card.plain: It marks the spot in preparation steps where the text asks you to work out how many vials or packets are needed.
